install: a launcher at {tooldir}/bin/aibom-generator that runs `python -m src.cli` from the clone
notes: Run with one model ID from the corpus; the project directory is not an input this tool accepts.
not_gradable: Takes a Hugging Face model ID, not a project, so it cannot be pointed at the corpus. Given one model ID from the corpus with huggingface.co unreachable, it wrote a schema-valid placeholder BOM and exited 0. Any discovery or safety number for it here would be an echo of its input, so no total is reported.
